The Orecreg fungarians are a group of fungarians who have overrun the Orecreg on the Isle of Dorn. Rustul Titancap is their leader. They were being researched by Yeonin and other earthen before they started spreading beyond the initial study site, forcing the researchers to evacuate. Spreading Sporbits and Festering Sporemasses can also be found alongside the fungarians. Many of the fungarians outside the mine can be seen fighting with Persistent Foragers. A while ago Modhina ventured into the quarry cave; she wanted to find rare ore for Hreka to help her craftsmanship; she however fell prey to the fungarians. Many of them were slain by adventurers sent to the quarry to collect their flesh,

An outsider is at least partially composed of the essence (but not necessarily the material) of some plane other than Azeroth. Some creatures start out as some other type of creature and become outsiders when they attain a higher (or lower) state of spiritual existence. Native outsiders are native to Azeroth. They are creatures who have mortal ancestors or a strong connection to Azeroth and can be raised, reincarnated, or resurrected just as other living creatures can be. Note: While outsider is used to describe a few specific races with similar characteristics, it does not mean that all are related.

Overflowing Fish Barrel is part of the process to acquire Otto (mount), a secret ottuk mount. Use the Brimming Fish Barrel after fishing up Kingfin, the Wise Whiskerfish by Algeth'ar Academy to make this barrel. Then return to the Hissing Grotto dive bar at off the northwestern coast of the Waking Shores and place the item where the Empty Fish Barrel was originally picked up. One of his employees was Obstorn. By the time of war in Khaz Algar, there was friction between Ardgrin and Steelvein due to less ore coming in, causing further interference with other shipments. They had a back-alley deal to smuggle in supplies otherwise prohibited by the Edicts. He was seemingly the one who tipped of the Peacekeepers about Steelvein and posted seditious posters. The Overflowing Rapids is an area found in central Waking Shores, east of Flayscale Camp and north of the Ruby Lifeshrine. It consists of numerous pools and the stretch of river they flow into, with most of their water originating from the Overflowing Spring. Several of the pools show signs of long-term geothermal activity. Various wild animals are common in the river, but most of the pools are home to water and steam elementals which have been agitated by the Primalists, causing issues for the wildlife. The Overflowing Spring is an area found within the Overflowing Rapids in the center of the Waking Shores, east of Flayscale Camp. It consists of three pools on a tall plateau, surrounded by dragon ruins and now occupied by Primalists and water elementals. According to Commander Lethanak, it was once a placid spring, but the Primalists have caused it to overflow, and it now risks causing floods in the valley. It is the site of the world quest, Cascading Conflict.
